born.why: This code optimizes survival by distinguishing between immediate starvation risks and long-term data gathering, using a pantry stock check to incentivize carrying safe fruits only when storage is low, and strictly avoiding known poisons unless facing imminent death.

The code prioritizes survival by eating at critical hunger levels, uses trait-based memory (color/shape) to generalize safety across species, and strategically carries safe food to the pantry when not starving to build a buffer against future starvation.

This code prioritizes survival by eating when starving, uses a stricter threshold for identifying poison (leaving on multiple harms or majority harm), and prefers carrying known-safe fruits to the pantry to secure future food, while cautiously tasting unknown fruits only when hunger allows.

The rewrite improves decision-making by distinguishing between "known safe" and "unknown" fruits more clearly, prioritizing carrying known-safe food when not already burdened to maximize efficiency, and using a threshold for poison confidence (2 hits) to avoid premature abandonment of potentially safe but initially unlucky encounters, while maintaining critical starvation gambles.

The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when hunger is critical, uses the diary to avoid known poisonous species (identified by past `harmed` events), and distinguishes between unknown fruits (which it tastes first) and known good ones (which it carries or eats).
